cited.quote: Breakfast Scheme was launched by the Hon'ble Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu on 15.09.2022

rationale: The promise is morning milk for school students. C1 and C3 show a Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme (food, classes 1-5), which is a related but different scheme. No extract shows an order or step for supplying milk. C2, C4 and C5 are about other subjects.

cited.quote: financial assistance of Rs.25,000 for non-graduates and Rs.50,000 for degree / diploma holders is given

rationale: C1 (2025-26) still describes marriage assistance of Rs.25,000 with an 8 gram gold coin; C2 and C3 show the same amounts. No extract shows a raise to Rs.30,000 for ST or hilly tribal women. C4 and C5 are unrelated tribal schemes.

No extract mentions the Saanarpatti - Moolakkadu Sambal irrigation project. C1 covers other Salem and Bhavani schemes, C4 is a road over bridge, C5 is a Coimbatore project. Nothing is about this commitment.

No extract concerns the Tamil Nadu Damage to Public Property Act or penalties for destroying public property with hazardous materials. C2 and C3 are Apartment Ownership Rules, C1 and C4 and C5 are unrelated.

cited.quote: a ‘Hosur Knowledge Corridor’ with world-class 51 infrastructure facilities will be set up along

rationale: C2 is a budget statement of a future Hosur Knowledge Corridor (an IT corridor, not the Chennai-Thiruperumputhur industrial corridor extension). C1 and C5 only study freight corridors; C4 covers other corridors. No GO or step extends that corridor to Hosur.

cited.quote: Government do hereby constitute a High Level Committee under the Chairmanship of Hon'ble Justice

rationale: C1 is G.O.(Ms) No.98 of 2022-06-01 constituting a High Level Committee of educationists and experts for a State Education Policy, following the budget announcement. The promise text does not name its goal, so the match rests on the wording (high-level committee of educationists and experts).

cited.quote: Tamil Nadu Journalist Welfare Board meetings have been conducted six times to discuss the various welfare schemes

rationale: C1 and C3 describe journalist welfare schemes, which are related activity only. No extract shows any order or step to withdraw cases against journalists. C2, C4 and C5 are about corruption cases and caste certificates.

cited.quote: additional 2.17 lakh households have been approved to be covered with toilet facilities under Phase II of SBM (G)

rationale: C1 (2021-12-29) reports approval of toilets for 2.17 lakh more rural households under SBM(G) Phase II, an official step but not an administrative order shown in a GO, and no construction is shown. C2 describes SBM(G) Phase II; C4 mentions toilets only for Anganwadi buildings.

cited.quote: The Hon’ble Chief Minister launched the Sanitary Workers’ Empowerment Scheme on 09.12.2022 at Madurai

rationale: C1 describes a sanitary workers' welfare scheme (training, safety, insurance), which is related but does not provide promotion based on Class 10 qualification. C2 to C5 are school toilets, a clean city campaign and other service rules; none shows such promotion.

cited.quote: National medalists of yesteryears who are in indigent circumstances are provided a monthly pension of Rs.6,000/- per head

rationale: C3 and C1 describe an existing pension for indigent former medalists aged 58 or more, with no dated new order or operationalisation within this term shown, and limited to indigent persons. C2 covers scholarships and C4 and C5 are general employee pensions. No dated step for the promised pension.
No extract concerns an expert committee or professional council for civil engineers. C2 lists health professional councils, C4 is a hydrocarbon expert committee, and the others are unrelated.

cited.quote: It is essential to upgrade and modernize the daily and weekly markets.

rationale: C2 discusses weekly markets run by urban local bodies but only plans modernisation and relocation; no extract shows an order cancelling fees on vendors. C5 sanctions market projects (infrastructure), not fee cancellation.

cited.quote: have decided to grant permission for conducting the below mentioned Tourism and Folk Art Festivals
Special folk art performances by 101 artistes and music and dance performances by 108 students

rationale: C4 is a GO of 2021-12-15 permitting government folk arts festivals; C1 reports folk art programmes at government-organised events and conferences in later years. No single order for featuring folk arts at all events, so the date is the earliest dedicated official measure.

cited.quote: The proposed Check Dam site lies in Javvathupatti village of Oddanchatram Taluk in Dindigul District

rationale: C4 (GO of 2022-02-23) sanctions check dams including one in Oddanchatram Taluk in the Amaravathi sub-basin, an official step. No extract shows it built or operating, nor any check dam or canal for Thoppampatti or the Varada and Shanmuga rivers. C1, C2, C5 are other locations.

No extract names the Aruvaal Mooku drainage system. C1 and C2 sanction flood drainage carriers at Edaiyur and Kaludhur odai, C3 is Veeranam tank flood works and C5 other flood works; these are different projects in Cuddalore district.

cited.quote: Pongal, a significant four-day harvest festival, features the exhilarating Jallikattu, a traditional bull-taming sport

rationale: C1 and C2 describe tourism department Pongal and Jallikattu events at Madurai; C3 and C4 are Pongal prize money for pensioners; C5 is Jallikattu background. None shows a district-wide Pongal folk arts and sports festival with competitions and prizes.

cited.quote: As per the announcement the said amount was handed over on 12.07.2021.
University of Toronto, Canada 2021 1,00,00,000/ - 11. University of Cologne, Germany 2021 1,25,00,000/

rationale: C4 reports Rs.1.25 crore handed over to Cologne University on 12.07.2021; C1 lists Tamil chairs at Toronto and Cologne in 2021 funded by the State, and C4 reports further chair funding for Houston in November 2022. Government funding for Tamil chairs abroad shows effect.

cited.quote: The Government is providing Rs.1,000/- per month as Old Age Pension.

rationale: C1 to C3 describe the scheme and the Rs.1,000 old age pension with no increase to Rs.2,000. C4 only shortens the payout period from 25 to 20 years, which does not raise the amount. C5 is a textile policy. No order raising assistance appears.

cited.quote: The State continues to press for implementation of the reservation followed by the State

rationale: C1 says the State surrenders 15% UG and 50% PG seats to the All India Quota and presses for its own reservation rule in them; this is a different demand from withdrawing the order and returning all seats to the state pool. C4 and C5 confirm the AIQ allocation continues.

cited.quote: Restoration of original capacity of 4 Reservoirs viz., Vaigai, Pechipparai, Amaravathy and Mettur

rationale: C1 and C3 are G.O.(Ms) No.70 of 2024-07-26 giving administrative sanction for desilting Pechiparai reservoir as a three-year pilot, an official step. No extract shows desilting actually carried out or completed; C2 describes earlier delays.
